ModMetaData.name: More Mod Patches for Expanded Materials - Metals
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Extends the material treatment of Expanded Materials - Metals (EMM) to modded Steel-costing buildings that EMM's own ModPatches do not cover.
Using EMM's own ArgonicCore PatchOperationDistributeCost with EMM's Steel-base parameters, it assigns: - Titanium to structural / heavy-machinery / turret frames - Copper to thermal / heat-exchange equipment - StainlessSteel to food / medical / plumbing bodies - Lead to nuclear shielding
Assignments are derived from EMM's own metal->function conventions, audited by an independent adversarial pass. Silicon/Germanium are intentionally omitted: EMM uses them only as Gold substitutes, and the modded electronics here carry Components, not Gold.
Load after Expanded Materials - Metals.
